title: Alignment handoff deltas — Product / Eng / Applied ML prep (Sam Patel)
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment prep — quick run-through and owner-level handoff
Date: 2026-03-11 (prep notes created 2026-03-10)
Attendees (expected): Sam Patel (host), Amira Gomez (Product), Jules Park (Eng IC), Nora Chen (Applied ML lead), Ravi Singh (platform)
Purpose: Create a compact agenda and identify deltas that block final roadmap commitments for Q2 features: A) streaming-multi-tenant caching, B) reduced-latency KV-cache warming, C) light-quantized model rollout policy
Context / constraints:
- Product needs a clear go/no-go list by 2026-03-18 to feed GTM launch plan.
- Eng capacity: two full-time engineers + one SRE available for feature window starting 2026-04-01; risk if more than 3x scope.
- Applied ML: model quantization experiments show average 12% drop in perplexity for 4-bit; need targeted evals on critical prompts.
- SLA target unchanged: 95 p50 < 60ms for short-chat flows; team must define fallback policy if quantized model misses quality thresholds.
Key agenda items:
1) Alignment on minimal viability for streaming-multi-tenant caching (what is MVP?)
2) Acceptance criteria for KV-cache warming improvements
3) Rollout strategy for quantized variants (canary %s, rollback triggers)
4) Dependencies and infra needs (autoscaling, dedicated pool config)
5) Risk register and mitigation owners
Notes / rough decisions in prep:
- MVP for streaming cache = prefix-based session caching + transparent eviction policy; must show 20% token-cost reduction in staging.
- KV warming improvement to include a TTL-based prefetcher; fallback remains cold-start path.
- Quantization rollout: start with internal-only canary at 5% traffic on non-critical prompt set; quality evaluation every 24h; automatic rollback if prompt-set accuracy drops > 2% absolute.
Open questions (need answers before 3/18):
- Product: Which customer segments are included in initial canary? (Amira)
- Research: Can we produce targeted eval harness for the 8 critical prompts by 3/17? (Nora)
- Eng: What infra config is needed to route 5% traffic to canary without impacting p99? (Jules/Ravi)
- Legal/Security: Any data residency implications for dedicated pool routing? (Sam to confirm)
Action items (owner — task — due):
- Amira — finalize canary customer segment list and success metrics (incl. business KPIs) — due 2026-03-15
- Nora — deliver eval harness + baseline numbers for 8 critical prompts (format: per-prompt accuracy + perplexity) — due 2026-03-17
- Jules — prototype canary routing in staging (traffic split controls + telemetry) — due 2026-03-16
- Ravi — confirm autoscaling and dedicated pool config required to support fallback policy; document costs estimate — due 2026-03-16
- Sam — coordinate with Legal for residency check; add to linked_artifacts — due 2026-03-15
- All — short daily async check-ins in #roadmap-alignment channel for the week 3/15–3/19
Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Quality regression from quantized models. Mitigation: strict per-prompt evaluation + 24h automated rollback and conservative initial traffic.
- Risk: Infra cost spike from warmers. Mitigation: feature-flagged warmers with cost budget cap; if exceeded, disable warmers.
- Risk: Missed dates due to eval slippage. Mitigation: prioritize critical prompts; temporary manual gating by Sam/Amira.
Parking lot (non-blocking items):
- Decide telemetry naming conventions for model-variant routing (Jules to propose)
- Long-term: consider model-specific fallback (e.g., reload larger model for specific prompts) — mention in Q3 roadmap
Meeting prep checklist for Sam (host):
- Confirm invites + slide with one-pager decisions/deltas
- Prepare 2-min demo of canary routing prototype (Jules)
- Have Nora's preliminary eval data or placeholders
- Bring cost estimate slide from Ravi
Draft email to stakeholders after sync (placeholder):
Subject: Quick update — roadmap deltas and canary plan
Body: short bullets: decisions made, actions with owners+due dates, next checkpoint 2026-03-18
Quick notes to self:
- Be explicit about 'must have' vs 'nice to have' to protect Eng runway
- Push for hard acceptance criteria, not vague success language
- If Legal flags residency, delay canary to dedicated pool-only
End of prep notes.
